## Constitution Ratified — v1.0.0

Written to `.specify/memory/constitution.md` (replacing the unfilled scaffold resolved from `constitution-template`).

**Version: 1.0.0** — initial ratification. The prior file was the bare template with every `[PLACEHOLDER]` intact, so there was no earlier version to bump from and no project-specific values to preserve. First concrete adoption of governance gets 1.0.0 rather than a MAJOR bump from 0.x.

**Principles** (5, as specified):

| # | Principle | Teeth it has |
|---|---|---|
| I | Standard Library Only | No runtime third-party imports; `pytest` is the only dev exemption |
| II | Fail Loudly | stderr + non-zero exit, raise rather than return sentinels, no swallowed exceptions |
| III | Every Requirement Is Testable | Requirement→test mapping recorded in plan; unmapped requirement = unimplemented |
| IV | Simplicity | Abstractions justified against the requirement forcing them; abstract on third occurrence |
| V | Secure by Default (NON-NEGOTIABLE) | OWASP Top 10 + ASVS requirements stated per spec/plan and tested like any other requirement |

Your security minimums became a dedicated **Security Baseline** section with all nine control families — untrusted input validation, no concatenation into SQL/shell/paths/markup, password hashing and secret storage, CSPRNG and constant-time comparison, size/time/memory limits, per-operation access control under concurrency, narrowest file permissions, and no personal data or secrets in output, logs, or errors. The baseline is framed as a floor that applies whether or not a feature's own spec restates it, and waiving a control requires a constitutional amendment rather than a per-feature decision — otherwise "secure by default" erodes one feature at a time.

Two further sections fill the template's remaining slots: **Development Workflow and Quality Gates** (specification, planning, implementation, review, and faithful-reporting gates, each wired to specific principles) and **Governance** (amendment procedure, MAJOR/MINOR/PATCH policy, compliance review).
